author: Espinosa & Ortea, 2002

note.en: A tiny polished snail, only a few millimetres long, that lives among sand and rubble and is hardly ever seen without a hand lens. Known here from 1 museum specimen record[^3]. Size is typical for the genus, not measured from the record.
note.es: Un caracol diminuto y pulido, de pocos milímetros, que vive entre arena y escombro coralino y casi nunca se ve sin una lupa. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo[^3]. El tamaño es típico del género, no medido en el registro.

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Punta Mona, Manzanillo, 2002)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
